about: The material lab's candidate sets (roadmap 1.4a; tools/material_lab.gd, tools/material_measure.py). Each set: the woods paint_woods.py --set=NAME paints from the game's strips with the Studio men's sheet as the style reference (docs/concept/targets/9_studio_men.png) into assets/textures/mlab_NAME/, at texels_per_metre; `boards` paints more boards than the game's wood has; `grade` scales a wood's lightness, contrast and chroma in L*a*b* when it is cut (no paid call); `ask` is added to the prompt. Nothing here is the game's until Sean approves a wood and it is moved into assets/textures/woods/.

studio1.note: The first pass at the Studio men (2026-10-21): every wood at 256 texels a metre (the men's clothes' detail is ~6 mm, the woods' at 128 is 14-34 mm), dark trim and framing given more boards (60% and 22% of their neighbours on Main Street repeat a strip).

recut256.note: No paint: the game's own paintings (raw/woods_<wood>.jpg, Oct 16) cut again at 256 texels a metre instead of 128, to see what density alone does beside the men.

recut512.note: No paint: the game's own paintings cut again at 512 texels a metre (half their painted resolution).
